entries.text: This scan found 27 open issues, spread over all 5 pages, and every one is high-severity: 5 critical and 22 serious. Fix the shared footer social links first, in src/Shell.jsx (lines 30-32): they wrap icon graphics only, so they carry no readable text and screen readers announce nothing for them. One fix in that shared markup clears all 15 of those elements at once. Next, the shared faint grey timestamp style in the footer (.site-footer p.muted) is too light on white to read; correcting that one style fixes it on all 5 pages.
